jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

OVERVIEW

📍 Remote - South Africa

Want to sit at the intersection of Support, Engineering, and Product? Clipboard is hiring Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) to act as the primary escalation layer for technical issues across our platform. You'll own the investigation, reproduction, and - where applicable- agent-assisted fix implementation that turns noisy customer reports into validated, high-signal work, so Engineering only receives production-ready problems for final review.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for people who love digging into hard problems with real diagnostic tools, who care about getting to the root cause rather than just clearing a queue, and who want their investigations to directly protect platform reliability for hundreds of thousands of healthcare workers and the facilities that depend on them.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Monitor escalation channels and the Technical Support queue in Zendesk, catching early signals of systemic problems before they reach customers

- Investigate complex product, platform, and data-layer issues using tools like Datadog, internal dashboards, and SQL, reproducing bugs and producing evidence-backed escalations to Engineering.

- Handle live incidents end-to-end, from detection to closure: React to an incident with urgency, coordinate across Support, Engineering, and Product, and keep stakeholders updated with clear, structured communication

- Implement fixes where appropriate, testing your changes before handing off to Engineering for final review and sign-off

- Perform Root Cause Analysis and post-incident reviews, translating each issue into learnings that reduce recurrence and improve monitoring

- Maintain operational workflows (geofence, facility quizzes, NFC) accurately and quickly while spotting trends for prevention

- Capture investigative learnings in clear troubleshooting guides and documentation, and submit structured proposals that turn recurring patterns into actionable improvements

- Uphold our values such as unreasonably fast, ownership, and uncomfortably high standards in every interaction

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Technical Fluency - You're comfortable investigating issues with observability tools (e.g., Datadog), writing SQL to interrogate data, and reasoning about APIs, backend configurations, and feature toggles. You can tell the difference between a UI, data, and code-level problem.

- Diagnostic Rigor - Every investigation you produce is thorough, evidence-based, and reproducible. You rule out config and data causes before escalating, and your write-ups are clear enough for another engineer to pick up without rework.

- End-to-End Ownership - You own problems from first report to confirmed resolution, including stakeholder updates and follow-through, with no gaps between hand-offs.

- Composure Under Pressure - You stay structured and calm during live incidents, balancing speed with accuracy and communicating clearly when stakes are high.

- Adaptability & Prioritization - You juggle structured work (incidents, bugs, workflows) with unplanned high-priority requests without letting SLAs slip.

- Systems & Prevention Thinking - You treat every issue as a chance to learn, identifying gaps in monitoring, tooling, or process and proposing fixes that prevent recurrence.

- Fluent, professional-level English communication, both written and verbal.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with observability and analytics tooling (Datadog, Sentry, Snowflake, or similar)

- Familiarity with SQL and reading application logs

- Background in technical support, SRE, incident response, or a related engineering-adjacent function

- Exposure to AI-assisted coding/agent tooling

- Experience in Ops, Support, or CX environments at scale

HIRING PROCESS

- Application Review

- Skills Assessment via Case Study

- Case Interview with Tech Support Team Lead

- Interview with Head of Worker Experience

Important Note: Clipboard operates 24/7. Team members work 5 days within a 7-day schedule, including weekend availability. Shifts are assigned based on business needs.

jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Clipboard is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to help build and run the systems behind our sales organization.

You'll work across Salesforce, data, automation, and internal tools to help our sales team operate more effectively. That might mean building an automation that eliminates a recurring workflow, investigating a messy data problem, redesigning part of our Salesforce setup, or building a new system from the ground up.

We are a small team with an unusual operating model. Much of our execution runs through AI agents that we direct and quality-check, allowing each analyst to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

This is equal parts builder and operator. You'll own systems end to end, work through ambiguous requests from reps and leadership, and be accountable for making sure the things you build actually work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own live systems. Take ownership of production systems such as account distribution, deal intelligence, competitor tracking, and data sync pipelines. You'll be accountable for their accuracy and reliability.

- Solve ambiguous problems. Work through requests from sales reps, managers, and leadership, figure out what is actually needed, and execute quickly.

- Direct AI agents. Write specs and prompts, supervise AI agents, and rigorously QA their output before it touches production data.

- Build automations and tools. Create scripts, scheduled jobs, Slack bots, and lightweight web apps that turn recurring manual work into scalable systems.

- Analyze and report. Use SQL and other tools to answer important revenue questions and build reporting the organization can trust.

- Guard data quality. Handle merges, deduplication, account mapping, enrichment, and other work required to keep our systems accurate at scale.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Evidence of building. You've built scripts, automations, tools, systems, or other solutions to real problems.

- AI-native working style. You already use AI to multiply your output and understand where it can fail and how to verify its work.

- High judgment under ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined problem, figure out what matters, and know when to act versus when to ask.

- Strong attention to detail. You're comfortable being the last line of defense before changes affect production systems and large datasets.

- Bias to ownership. When something you own breaks, you don't just fix the immediate issue. You look for the underlying problem and improve the system.

SQL and Python experience are strong pluses, but we're more interested in your curiosity, judgment, and ability to ship than checking every technical box.

NICE TO HAVE

- Salesforce administration or development experience, including flows, SOQL, or data model design.

- Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, analytics, or a similar environment.

- Experience building automations with tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Application Review – We'll review your experience and evidence of things you've built, automated, or owned.

2. Take-Home Assessment – A practical, ~2-hour assessment using a fictional company, mock website, and CRM. You'll have 48 hours to complete it, and AI tools are encouraged.

3. Technical Walkthrough – A 30-minute session where you'll demo what you built, explain your decisions, and make a small live change to your system.

4. Manager Interview – A 30-minute conversation focused on communication, ownership, judgment, and how you operate under ambiguity.

5. Final Steps / Offer! – Some candidates may have an executive conversation, followed by references and an offer.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive base salary

- Insurance benefits + 401k options

- Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays

- Remote-first working environment

To get a better understanding of the general type of people we want to hire, you can check out our blog here. https://creatingvalue.substack.com/

We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the role:

An indispensable component of Clipboard's marketplace is its workplace customers. The Customer Success Manager ensures the continued success of the partnership between Clipboard and its workplace partners, working to deliver an optimal experience at every level of their organizations. The job encompasses being a resource to workplaces when issues arise, liaising with building- and corporate-level contacts, and keeping abreast of a litany of important business metrics for each account.

Your week will be balanced between high-touch customer engagement and internal account strategy, with a laser focus on net revenue retention. You are an avid problem-solver, a strategic communicator, and a diligent executor who can navigate complex relationships to sharpen your business acumen.

Responsibilities:

- Manage & grow your portfolio: Own a book of business with accountability for "Same-Store Shift Postings" (SSSP, which measures utilization) and "Same-Store Net Revenue" (SSNR, which measures profitability). In your pursuit of driving those numbers higher, you will identify churn risks, mitigate issues, and proactively uncover opportunities for commercial expansion.

- Strategic account planning: Build and maintain detailed account plans. Forecast performance accurately and provide regular insights to internal leadership regarding pipeline health and account stability.

- Drive executive value: Establish trust with both clinical and non-clinical executives. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and strategic meetings to demonstrate value, align on business goals, and negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes.

- Operational excellence: Act as the primary point of contact for complex escalations, ensuring rapid resolution while implementing systemic solutions to prevent recurrence.

- Cross-functional advocacy: Partner with Product, Legal, and Strategy Operations to represent the voice of the customer, driving product improvements and internal initiatives that optimize the client experience.

Beyond the basics, what will make you successful:

- Extreme ownership: The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You're self-reliant, and can get things done in the chaos that is an early-stage startup scaling quickly.

- Extreme curiosity: You ask "why" 3-5 times in a row for the same problem, digging and digging and not being satisfied until you truly understand the root cause.

- Scrappiness: You look for ways through problems and refuse to let obstacles derail your progress. You bring solutions instead of asking ‘what should I do?’

- Fast-paced: You thrive on moving quickly and are highly adaptable to a market that evolves quickly.

Our interview process:

1. Application (where you are now!)

2. Case study

3. Interview 1 with a hiring manager

4. Interview 2 with Head of Account Management

5. Culture chat with a partner on our People Team

Why a case study first?

Since this role is remote and requires a high degree of autonomy, the case study helps us understand how you operate in an asynchronous environment. Specifically, we’re looking at how you interpret written context, navigate ambiguity, and identify opportunities independently. This ensures our first conversation is grounded in your actual work style rather than just a resume walkthrough.

- Relationship management experience not required but strongly preferred

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Willingness to try / lack of fear

- Bachelor's Degree

Benefits:

- Operational excellence: Act as the primary point of contact for complex escalations, ensuring rapid resolution while implementing systemic solutions to prevent recurrence.

- Cross-functional advocacy: Partner with Product, Legal, and Strategy Operations to represent the voice of the customer, driving product improvements and internal initiatives that optimize the client experience.

- Extreme ownership: The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You're self-reliant, and can get things done in the chaos that is an early-stage startup scaling quickly.

ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a leader to own and build the product strategy and execution for our Home Health & Hospice vertical.

Reporting to the Vertical Owner of Home Health & Hospice (HH&H), you’ll work closely with Engineering, Design, Operations, Sales, and customers to turn business priorities and customer needs into high-quality products.

Our HH&H Vertical is our fastest-growing New Vertical, and the biggest challenge we face is building a working marketplace that improves the connection between supply and demand. The product that works so successfully in our core long-term care marketplace has not translated into the Home Health and Hospice market. We now need to build our product to solve the unique problems home health agencies face and ensure we can meet their needs effectively.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the product roadmap for Home Health & Hospice, following the Vertical Owner’s prioritization

- Translate business priorities and customer needs into clear product requirements and solutions

- Lead product development from discovery and scoping through launch and iteration

- Partner closely with Engineering and Design to make tradeoffs and ship high-quality experiences

- Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand workflows, pain points, and product feedback

- Prioritize improvements based on customer impact, business value, and engineering effort

- Measure product adoption and performance and continuously improve the experience

- Partner with Vertical Owner and Revenue organization to determine new potential markets for expansion

- Partner with Strategy & Operations to modify product/support product for other potential lines of business like Physical Therapy and Home Infusions

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 4+ years of product management and/or strategy experience

- Strong track record of building and shipping customer-facing products, preferably that impacted the real world.

- Excellent product judgment and ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements

- Strong customer empathy and comfort working directly with users

- Ability to work effectively across Engineering, Design, Operations, and commercial teams

- Enough SQL knowledge to correct LLMs when they write a misleading query

- Strong analytical and communication skills

- Experience in healthcare, marketplaces, or operationally complex products is a plus

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Application Review

2. Case Study

3. Case Study Interview

4. Hiring Manager Interview (s)

5. Culture Interview

6. Offer!

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.
